dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent macro-annuli exhibit irregular, crenulated light-intensity perimeters with sharp step-gradients against a dark-gray background. These perimeters form closed 'O' shapes with jagged, non-uniform widths and semi-open 'C' shapes particularly in the posterior-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, dark, sub-circular pixel clusters (spots) distributed throughout the centers of the annuli and the interstitial spaces. These spots lack internal gradients and appear as solid low-intensity points against the lighter ring interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary cluster of three large annuli in the mid-dorsal region forms a scalene triangular geometry between their centroids. A secondary sequence of smaller rings forms an approximately linear chain extending toward the posterior flipper.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized region of high-intensity specular reflection (overexposure) on the lower-mid flank and upper flipper area obscures the underlying textural topology in that specific quadrant.
